critical_finding: Weekly label and known_date are different facts. A W-FRI label may be future-dated while the current partial bucket contains only data known today. known_date alone does not prove the calendar week is complete. Exact holiday-short-week availability requires the session/calendar owner; conservative label<=asof drops incomplete buckets but delays a holiday-short completed week until Friday.
safe_first_wave_contract: Use the same Daily source to derive Weekly bars. Exclude an in-progress week. Carry both W-FRI label and actual source known_date. For normal weeks, label<=decision_asof is sufficient. For a Friday holiday/closure, use the canonical session calendar to prove the prior trading session is the final session of that W-FRI bucket before making the weekly value available. If calendar proof is unavailable, delay availability conservatively; never expose the partial bucket.
